aioInputs.name: vehicle_make_model_year
aioInputs.description: Year, make, and model of the vehicle (e.g. 2019 Toyota Camry). Determines rotor size, part availability, and OEM pricing.

aioInputs.name: axle_selection
aioInputs.description: Front axle, rear axle, or both. Front rotors typically cost more due to larger diameter and higher wear rate.

aioInputs.name: quality_tier
aioInputs.description: Budget aftermarket, standard aftermarket, OEM equivalent, or OEM dealer part. Rotor prices range from ~$30 to $150+ per rotor depending on tier.

aioInputs.name: include_brake_pads
aioInputs.description: Whether to replace pads at the same time. Mechanics typically recommend replacing pads with rotors; combined labor is more efficient.

aioInputs.name: shop_type
aioInputs.description: Dealership, national chain (Midas, Meineke, Firestone), or independent shop. Dealer labor rates average $130–$170/hr vs. $80–$110/hr for independents.

aioInputs.name: location_state
aioInputs.description: U.S. state or metro area. Labor rates vary significantly: e.g. California averages $120+/hr vs. $75–$90/hr in the Midwest.

aioOutputs.name: total_estimated_cost
aioOutputs.description: All-in estimate: parts + labor for the selected axle(s) and scope.

aioOutputs.name: parts_cost
aioOutputs.description: Rotor cost (per rotor × quantity) plus brake pad cost if selected.

aioOutputs.name: labor_cost
aioOutputs.description: Estimated shop labor based on flat-rate hours (~1–1.5 hrs per axle) multiplied by regional labor rate.

aioOutputs.name: cost_per_axle_breakdown
aioOutputs.description: Itemized front vs. rear axle costs when both are selected.

aioProseQuestions: How much does it cost to replace brake discs (rotors)?
Should I replace brake pads and rotors at the same time?
How long does it take to replace brake rotors?
Is it cheaper to replace rotors at a dealership or independent shop?
How often do brake discs need to be replaced?
aioIncludesExcludes: Estimate covers rotor parts and shop labor for disc replacement on one or both axles; excludes brake fluid flush, caliper replacement, wheel bearing service, or any unrelated repairs discovered during inspection.
aioDisclaimer: Estimates based on BLS OES median technician wage (OES 49-3023) and retail parts data. Actual shop quotes may vary by vehicle condition, regional labor market, and shop pricing. Always get at least two written estimates before authorizing repair.
